title: Can YOU Fix Climate Change?
summary: Kurzgesagt examines what individuals can do about climate change, covering lesser-known carbon sources and why systemic and political change matter more than personal footprints.
why: Cited in climate threads to argue that individual action is not enough and that political pressure is needed.

quote.text: It's a Kurzgesagt video about why individual action is far from enough, and why we need systemic action.
